lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  have hpos : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (Ne.symm (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀))
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc) x₀ hpos
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hz := hg _
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right (f := (φ : Y → ℝ)) (g := fun _ => f x₀)
      ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  refine ((φ.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    (μ := μ) (x := x₀) φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right ?_
    (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))) (ne_of_gt hpos))).ne' hz
  intro x
  by_cases hx : φ x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hball (φ.support_eq ▸ hx)).le
